# [04/10] Backend — Parcel Booking, Pricing and Dispatch Source

## A. Ownership and metadata

- **Execution order:** 04/10; coordination order, not a sequential wait queue.
- **Primary developer:** @Jathuja — exactly one implementation assignee.
- **Independent reviewer:** @Kiruthiyan — different team member, review only.

- **Estimated remaining effort:** 29 relative points, conditional where policy-blocked; review effort separate, not hours.
- **Owned services/files:** S2 parcel/booking/pricing, authoritative dispatch-source provider and read API; exclude new receipt package owned by 08. No shared proto/gateway writes.
- **Suggested branch:** `feature/353-parcel-booking-pricing-and-dispatch-source`.
- **Base branch / PR target:** `develop`.
- **Readiness:** Dependent — independent characterization starts now; only the named runtime sub-tasks wait.
- **Audited source:** `a6e738cff764505e47efa1ee7ae875239cfa0168`, latest origin/develop checked 2026-11-12. No source/test/config/docs changes were made by this planning operation.
- **Target Project:** [Project #9, View #1](https://github.com/users/pirathee587/projects/9/views/1); initial **Todo**.

## B. Objective and authoritative ownership

Deliver the verified remaining **Parcel Booking, Pricing and Dispatch Source** work below; preserve completed implementation. This new consolidated main issue is the implementation authority for its listed scope. The previous 43 issues and Project #7 are unchanged historical references, not parallel implementation queues. Historical assignees may conflict with this new allocation; do not follow an old assignee as a second implementation owner.

## C–D. Existing implementation, classified gaps and remaining tasks

### G01 — Authoritative dispatch candidate and guarded claim API

**Classification:** MISSING / BLOCKED. **Service:** S2. **Priority:** Critical. **Effort:** 8 points. **Reference:** [#346](https://github.com/pirathee587/Zentro/issues/346).

**Verified current code / preserve:** ParcelBookingRepository stores authoritative parcels; parcel_pricing.proto defines only GetParcel and S2 has no gRPC server. No enumerable eligible-parcel/conditional claim API exists.

- [ ] **Remaining deliverable:** Approve eligibility, enumeration completeness, conditional claim, release and crash recovery with S3; implement the S2 side only. Reuse booking/lifecycle persistence; add forward-only migration only if approved protocol requires it.
- [ ] **Acceptance:** Real S2 returns approved candidates and rejects missing/stale/terminal parcels; concurrent claims have one winner; timeout/crash/retry cannot leave an unrecoverable claim; no cross-service SQL.
- [ ] **Required tests/evidence:** PostgreSQL eligibility and claim races, replay, rollback, dependency timeout and recovery; real S2/S3 contract tests.
- **Dependencies/readiness:** G14 contract approval; S2/S3 lifecycle owners. Resolve against the new main-package ownership below; G identifiers denote audited findings, not additional primary owners.

### G10 — Server-owned destination classification

**Classification:** BUG / BLOCKED. **Service:** S2. **Priority:** High. **Effort:** 8 points. **Reference:** [#301](https://github.com/pirathee587/Zentro/issues/301).

**Verified current code / preserve:** ParcelBookingService.price forwards caller destinationType with null zones; engine uses it for cross-district surcharge. Controlled city mapping is absent. #301 remains design pending.

- [ ] **Remaining deliverable:** Get city/zone semantics, mapping/seed ownership and legacy rollout approved; derive server-side for booking, merchant orders and both estimates; preserve existing validated input/idempotency. Backend scope only; identify frontend consumer dependency separately.
- [ ] **Acceptance:** Spoofed classification cannot change same-route fee; unknown/inactive city handled by approved contract; customer/merchant/estimate parity; response/persistence use derived value; authorized candidate report does not automatically reprice.
- [ ] **Required tests/evidence:** Same-city/same-zone/cross-zone, forged classification, inactive/missing codes, legacy rollout, persistence and idempotency regression.
- **Dependencies/readiness:** Explicit product approval recorded on #301; G14 contracts. Resolve against the new main-package ownership below; G identifiers denote audited findings, not additional primary owners.

### G11 — Dimension quote versus booking consistency

**Classification:** PARTIAL / BLOCKED. **Service:** S2. **Priority:** Medium. **Effort:** 3 points. **Reference:** [#306](https://github.com/pirathee587/Zentro/issues/306).

**Verified current code / preserve:** PricingCalculationEngine uses max(actual,L*W*H/5000); CreateParcelBookingRequest and CreateMerchantOrderRequest have no dimensions. Booking supplies null dimension fields. #306 is decision pending.

- [ ] **Remaining deliverable:** Approve estimate rejection or full booking support and consumer compatibility. Implement chosen backend contract consistently, including fingerprint/persistence if dimensions become billable; do not choose business policy during audit.
- [ ] **Acceptance:** 50x40x30 cm at 1 kg cannot silently quote 12 kg and book 1 kg under the approved contract; both aliases and merchant parity tested with partial/null/type boundaries.
- [ ] **Required tests/evidence:** Quote/book equality or explicit approved rejection; dimensional boundary, legacy replay and both estimate routes.
- **Dependencies/readiness:** Product decision on #306; coordinate #301. Resolve against the new main-package ownership below; G identifiers denote audited findings, not additional primary owners.

### G12 — Same-address decision

**Classification:** BLOCKED. **Service:** S2 policy/contracts. **Priority:** Low. **Effort:** 1 points. **Reference:** [#305](https://github.com/pirathee587/Zentro/issues/305).

**Verified current code / preserve:** Address validation checks shape but not pickup/dropoff equality. #305 explicitly leaves reject versus warning and normalization undecided.

- [ ] **Remaining deliverable:** Record product choice and exact normalization/compatibility in #305 and API docs. Hand approved S2 implementation to Jathuja in the same serialized S2 workstream; Jathuja owns the S2 implementation after separate product approval.
- [ ] **Acceptance:** Decision states reject/warn, casing/Unicode/trim rules and error keys; Jathuja tests customer/merchant equality and meaningful differences; rejected path stores nothing.
- [ ] **Required tests/evidence:** Contract examples and normalization cases; implementation tests owned by S2 owner after approval.
- **Dependencies/readiness:** Product/coordinator decision. Resolve against the new main-package ownership below; G identifiers denote audited findings, not additional primary owners.

### G13 — Zone administration and authoritative pricing availability contract

**Classification:** PARTIAL / BLOCKED. **Service:** S2. **Priority:** Medium. **Effort:** 3 points. **Reference:** [#194](https://github.com/pirathee587/Zentro/issues/194).

**Verified current code / preserve:** ZoneController reads active zones only; no /admin/zones controller. Pricing admin GET/PUT is implemented and validated. ZoneService and PricingService return approved defaults on DB failure/empty data; fallback tests explicitly pin that behavior.

- [ ] **Remaining deliverable:** Confirm whether mutable zone CRUD is required and approve operations/error semantics; implement only missing approved operations. Review default fallback observability/failure policy without changing approved fees or fallback behavior unilaterally.
- [ ] **Acceptance:** Approved required zone operations are Dispatcher-only and documented/tested; unchanged rules retain pricing regression; outage behavior matches explicit decision and never falsely claims DB persistence.
- [ ] **Required tests/evidence:** Zone lifecycle/authorization if approved; pricing persistence failures and configured-rule/default behavior; estimate boundaries.
- **Dependencies/readiness:** Zone CRUD and fallback policy approval; #301 canonical city design. Resolve against the new main-package ownership below; G identifiers denote audited findings, not additional primary owners.

### G43 — Bounded list/history traversal and capacity decision

**Classification:** PARTIAL / BLOCKED. **Service:** Backend performance/contracts. **Priority:** Medium. **Effort:** 3 points. **Reference:** [#257](https://github.com/pirathee587/Zentro/issues/257).

**Verified current code / preserve:** Existing opt-in PerformanceSmokeIT and follow-up report measure S1 whole-array admin lists, S3 lifetime courier history/workload, S4 whole public histories and S2 merchant history limited to first 100 without traversal. No new performance run was executed in this audit. S4 mine already caps size 100. Historical workload p95 exceeded the documented 1000 ms goal at 25 clients; no cause or production capacity is established.

- [ ] **Remaining deliverable:** Reuse #257 and existing performance evidence to prioritize a backward-compatible bounded traversal contract with service owners: S1 user/merchant/courier lists; S3 queue/eligible/workload after source exists and courier history; S2 merchant orders; S4 public history/SSE catch-up. Establish realistic zone cardinality before zone pagination. Keep legacy responses until approved migration. This issue owns measurement/contract decisions only; any approved service implementation is scoped to that service owner in a follow-up, never a second primary implementation owner.
- [ ] **Acceptance:** Document per-resource cardinality, size cap, stable unique sort tie, traversal/count semantics, compatibility and owning service; measured cases reference exact SHA/environment; unsupported capacity claims avoided; implement only approved needed changes through separate service-owned scopes.
- [ ] **Required tests/evidence:** Reproduce only justified opt-in workload/growth cases in disposable environment; no simultaneous performance and reactor run; union/order/owner-set/page-boundary acceptance specified per resource.
- **Dependencies/readiness:** G14 contract agreement; G01/G02 before actual queue benchmark; realistic volume/SLO input. Resolve against the new main-package ownership below; G identifiers denote audited findings, not additional primary owners.

### X01 — Authoritative parcel retrieval / booking Location

**Classification:** MISSING / BLOCKED. **Service:** Parcel Booking, Pricing and Dispatch Source. **Priority:** High. **Effort:** 3 points. **Reference:** [#191](https://github.com/pirathee587/Zentro/issues/191).

**Verified current code / preserve:** S2 ParcelBookingController returns Location /api/v1/parcels/{id}; no matching GET controller exists and gateway denies unlisted parcel reads. WARP S2 owns parcel details.

- [ ] **Remaining deliverable:** Agree an owner-scoped authoritative detail/list contract or explicitly select the approved tracking read resource and repair the Location contract. Implement only needed S2 read endpoints; receipts remain hephzibah-peries-owned new files. Never expose another customer/merchant parcel.
- [ ] **Acceptance:** Real created Location resolves as approved; owner/foreign owner/wrong-role/unknown-ID and idempotent replay tests pass; approved route registered through package 02.
- [ ] **Required tests/evidence:** Real created Location resolves as approved; owner/foreign owner/wrong-role/unknown-ID and idempotent replay tests pass; approved route registered through package 02.
